content: Open AI Chat and describe what you need. Try a suggested question or write your own, then check the answer and refine your request if needed.

comment.text: Body of the AI Agents onboarding tour step that highlights the chat message box and suggested questions inside the user's own agent. AI Chat is the UI name of the agent's chat section.
